label: Infrastructure need
description: Document the infrastructure, energy, or workforce gap the project closes for a rural Alaska community.

scoring.desc: Need is asserted without community or engineering data.
Need is described with one data source but no community corroboration.
Need is documented with engineering or energy assessments and community input.

common_failures: No engineering scope or energy baseline

label: Project readiness
description: Show site control, permits, engineering design stage, and procurement readiness.

scoring.desc: Project is conceptual with no design or permits.
Design is underway but permits or site control are pending.
Design is at 65 percent or higher, permits are in hand or on a clear timeline, and site control is documented.

label: Organizational capacity
description: Show the tribe, local government, or nonprofit has the capacity to manage a federal award and construction.

scoring.desc: Applicant has no prior federal award or construction experience.
Applicant has prior experience but not at this scale.
Applicant has prior federal awards at comparable scale with clean audits and a named project manager.

label: Budget and leverage
description: Present a reasonable cost estimate with identified leverage from state, tribal, or other federal sources.

scoring.desc: Budget has no leverage or leverage is uncommitted.
Leverage is identified but letters are pending.
Leverage is committed in writing with match amounts and timing.

common_failures: Uncontingent contingency missing for Alaska construction

label: Sustainability and operations and maintenance
description: Describe how the asset will be operated and maintained after the award period with a funded O&M plan.

scoring.desc: No O&M plan or identified operator.
O&M plan exists but funding source is uncertain.
O&M plan has an identified operator, funding source, and training plan for local staff.

common_failures: O&M funded only by anticipated user fees
